title: Feedback on documentation about torch.matmul
bug_description:
There is the following issue on this page: https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.matmul.html#torch.matmul

The sentence **"a 1 is prepended to its dimension for the purpose of the matrix multiply. After the matrix multiply, the prepended dimension is removed."**, in bullet point 3, under the heading **"The behavior depends on the dimensionality of the tensors as follows:"** sounds a bit unclear.
A clearer wording could be **"1 is prepended to its dimension for the purpose of the matrix multiply. After the matrix multiply, the prepended dimension is removed."**, with "a" removed before "1".

cc @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
